Base multiplier for all damageable items. 2 = double durability. Set to 1 to disable multiplier. Clamps at integer max to prevent overflow.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_multiplier_weapons: Multiplier for all weapon items. Overrides Global if > 0. Set to 0 to use Global value.
Specific multiplier for Swords (#minecraft:swords). Overrides Global if > 0. Set to 0 to use Global value.
Specific multiplier for Spears. Overrides Global if > 0. Set to 0 to use Global value.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_multiplier_trident: Specific multiplier for Tridents. Overrides Global if > 0. Set to 0 to use Global value.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_multiplier_maces.d: Specific multiplier for Maces. Overrides Global if > 0. Set to 0 to use Global value.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_multiplier_bows.de: Specific multiplier for Bows. Overrides Global if > 0. Set to 0 to use Global value.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_multiplier_crossbo: Specific multiplier for Crossbows. Overrides Global if > 0. Set to 0 to use Global value.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_multiplier_tools.d: Specific multiplier for Tools: Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, Hoes, Spears. Overrides Global if > 0.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_multiplier_armor.d: Specific multiplier for all Armor items (Head, Chest, Legs, Feet). Overrides Global if > 0.
Specific multiplier for Elytra. Overrides Global if > 0.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_infinity_global.de: If true, ALL damageable items become unbreakable. Takes priority over multipliers.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_infinity_weapons.d: If true, all Weapons become unbreakable.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_infinity_swords.de: If true, Swords become unbreakable. Overrides Global Infinity.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_infinity_tools.des: If true, Tools (Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, Hoes, Spears) become unbreakable.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_infinity_armor.des: If true, all Armor becomes unbreakable.
gamerule.minecraft.dm_show_tooltip.descr: If true, shows the effective durability modifier on item tooltips (e.g. '2x Tools' or 'UNBREAKABLE').
If true, shows per-weapon-type multiplier and god mode settings (Swords, Bows, Crossbows, Spears, Tridents, Maces). If false, only Global settings are visible.
